notes: Alipay and WeChat Pay work with foreign cards, and cash is rarely needed; the metro is cheap and extensive (3-7 CNY). The maglev reaches Pudong in 8 minutes.
Visa: in 2026 many countries get 30 days visa-free (check for Türkiye); set up a VPN beforehand for Google and WhatsApp.
Summer is 35°C and humid; typhoons occur in July and August. Do the Bund in the morning, museums and shopping centres in the afternoon, and Pudong's lights at night.
Xiaolongbao costs 30-50 CNY; go to Yang's for shengjianbao; brunch in the French Concession runs 100+.
Museums are free but need an online reservation with your passport; buy your Shanghai Tower ticket online.
No tipping; bargaining is expected in markets but not in shops.

stops.name: The Bund
stops.tips: A row of colonial buildings with Pudong opposite; locals practise tai chi in the morning, and it's free of crowds.

stops.name: Nanjing Road East
stops.tips: China's busiest pedestrian street; stop at Shanghai First Food Store.

stops.name: People's Square & Shanghai Museum
stops.tips: Bronze and porcelain collections; free entry, reserve with your passport.

stops.name: Yang's Fry Dumplings
stops.tips: Shengjianbao (pan-fried soup dumplings); Huanghe Road, bite and sip technique.

stops.name: Bund Gece Manzarası
stops.tips: Pudong lights 19:00-22:00; a Huangpu river cruise (~120 CNY) is optional.

backups.name: Jia Jia Tang Bao
backups.tips: The xiaolongbao legend; Huanghe Road, closes early.

backups.name: Huangpu River Cruise
backups.tips: Night river cruise; an alternative to the Bund.

days.theme: Yu Garden and the Old City

stops.name: Yu Garden
stops.tips: Classical Ming-dynasty garden; quiet at the 08:30 opening, with a zigzag bridge.

stops.name: Yuyuan Bazaar
stops.tips: A bazaar around the garden; souvenirs and tea.

stops.name: Nanxiang Mantou Dian
stops.tips: Where xiaolongbao was born, since 1900; sit-down upstairs, takeaway with a queue downstairs.

stops.name: City God Temple
stops.tips: Taoist temple in the middle of the bazaar.

stops.name: Tianzifang
stops.tips: Workshops and cafes in shikumen alleys; French Concession.

backups.name: Lin Long Fang
backups.tips: Local xiaolongbao; French Concession, no tourists.

backups.name: Huxinting Teahouse
backups.tips: Teahouse above the Yu Garden lake.

stops.name: Shanghai Tower Top of Shanghai
stops.tips: 118th floor, 632 m; clear air in the morning, and the world's fastest lift.

stops.name: Lujiazui Pedestrian Bridge
stops.tips: From the circular bridge you see the Oriental Pearl and the towers.

stops.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
stops.tips: 155 m underwater tunnel; good with children.

stops.name: Din Tai Fung Pudong
stops.tips: Xiaolongbao and chicken soup; air-conditioned.

stops.name: Century Park
stops.tips: Pudong's huge park; lake and cycling.

backups.name: Shanghai Grandma Pudong
backups.tips: Local Shanghai cuisine; hongshao rou (red-braised pork).

backups.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
backups.tips: Retro pink tower; an alternative to Shanghai Tower.

stops.name: Wukang Road
stops.tips: Plane-tree-lined avenue and Wukang Mansion; art deco villas and cafes.

stops.name: Propaganda Poster Art Centre
stops.tips: Mao-era posters in an apartment block basement; hidden and fascinating.

stops.name: Fu 1039
stops.tips: Shanghai cuisine in a 1913 villa; drunken chicken and red-braised pork.

stops.name: Xintiandi
stops.tips: Cafes in restored shikumen houses; the Museum of the First National Congress of the Communist Party is free.

stops.name: Fuxing Park
stops.tips: French-style park; retirees dance and play mahjong.

backups.name: Jesse Restaurant
backups.tips: The old Jesse; hongshao rou, book ahead.

backups.name: Shanghai Museum of Art Pudong
backups.tips: New museum opposite the Bund; an alternative to Xintiandi.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Fangsheng Bridge
stops.tips: 1 hour on Metro Line 17; five-arch bridge built in 1571; go in the morning before the tour buses arrive.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Canal Boat Tour
stops.tips: Gondola along the canals; 20 minutes.

stops.name: Kezhi Garden
stops.tips: The town's classical garden; entry with a combined ticket.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Canalside Restaurant
stops.tips: Zongzi (sticky rice dumplings) and pork trotters; riverside tables.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Bei Dajie
stops.tips: Shops along the northern street; roasted chestnuts.

backups.name: Ah Po Cha Lou Zhujiajiao
backups.tips: Teahouse over the canal; dim sum.

backups.name: Qibao Ancient Town
backups.tips: Water town close to the city; a shorter alternative to Zhujiajiao.

stops.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
stops.tips: 25 minutes by high-speed train from Hongqiao; China's most famous classical garden, UNESCO-listed.

stops.name: Suzhou Museum
stops.tips: I.M. Pei's white-and-grey museum; free entry, reservation required.

stops.name: Pingjiang Road
stops.tips: Old street running along a canal; silk shops and teahouses.

stops.name: Pingjiang Road Noodle House
stops.tips: Suzhou sweet noodle soup.

stops.name: Tiger Hill
stops.tips: Leaning pagoda and the tomb of the King of Wu; return train at 18:00.

backups.name: Shantang Street
backups.tips: Canal street; an alternative to Tiger Hill.

stops.name: Jing'an Temple
stops.tips: Gold-roofed temple among skyscrapers; Jing'an.

stops.name: Jing'an Kerry Centre
stops.tips: Shopping centre; souvenirs and coffee.

stops.name: Xiaoyang Shengjian Jing'an
stops.tips: Shengjianbao; a farewell lunch.

stops.name: Maglev Longyang Road
stops.tips: Reach Pudong Airport in 8 minutes on the 430 km/h maglev; a fitting farewell.

backups.name: Jing'an Sculpture Park
backups.tips: Sculpture park and the Natural History Museum.
